Senior Software Engineer role at Rancher Government Solutions, building cloud-native infrastructure and microservices for U.S. federal agencies operating in regulated, compliance-bound environments. The work centers on Go development against Kubernetes extension patterns — controllers, operators, and custom resource definitions — along with CI/CD pipelines and GitOps delivery via Helm and Kustomize. Core stack is Go, Kubernetes, containers, and Linux, with federal cloud platforms and Vue.js/Nuxt front-end work as secondary exposure.
